findings.title: Reset methods insert the same unique active grant
findings.scenario: Run both reset methods in the same Spring context, in either order.
findings.expected: Both methods reach their security assertions independently.
findings.actual: Both grant security.mfa_reset to persistent otp-admin; the second insertion violates the active-grant unique index.
findings.evidence: Insert helper at lines 81–82 is called at 108 and 143. AfterEach restores policies only. V4__grants_and_audit.sql:22 enforces unique active (user_id, permission). Static finding; container execution NOT_RUN.
findings.suggested_fix: Use separate administrators or restore grant fixtures after each method.
findings.repro_test: Execute both methods in MfaResetIntegrationTest against CI containers.

findings.title: Default test overwrites migration defaults before asserting them
findings.scenario: A migration accidentally seeds STAFF or KITCHEN as REQUIRED.
findings.expected: The default-policy test detects the incorrect seed.
findings.actual: BeforeEach rewrites all policies to OPTIONAL before checking their defaults.
findings.evidence: Setup at lines 49–60 precedes assertions at 98–107; production seeds are in V31__mfa_policy.sql:14.
findings.suggested_fix: Assert all three defaults against a fresh migrated database before fixture mutation.
findings.repro_test: In a disposable checkout, mutate only STAFF's seed to REQUIRED and verify the defaults test fails.

findings.title: Response flag does not verify session invalidation
findings.scenario: Provider logout becomes a no-op while reset still returns sessionsEnded=true.
findings.expected: Tests detect continued refresh-token or existing SSO-session use after reset or disable.
findings.actual: Reset checks the response flag and starts a fresh browser; preference-disable tests never verify provider session termination.
findings.evidence: Reset lines 109–127 retain no refresh token or target browser. MfaPolicyIntegrationTest:158–179 checks preference behavior without session reuse. Static coverage finding, not an observed logout failure.
findings.suggested_fix: Retain refresh tokens and SSO browsers before reset/disable and assert invalidation afterward.
findings.repro_test: A no-op logout mutation must fail real-provider invalidation tests, allowing the documented access-token expiry window.
